prompt: A candy factory: sort the sweets into the right boxes

intent.setting: A candy factory (a colorful shop-floor where assorted sweets spill out at one end and numbered or labelled boxes sit in rows at the other)
intent.goal: Move each sweet to the box that matches its type before any boxes overflow
intent.fail: A box overflows or a sweet is left on the floor when the conveyor stops
intent.headline: Matching each sweet to the correct box before the floor stops is the core puzzle
